record_type_quote: Thus, in the current study we conducted two experiments where we sought to replicate recent findings (Romanska et al., 2015;Barbieri et al., 2016) reporting enhanced face perception following transcranial electrical stimulation techniques. The primary aim of Experiment 1 was to replicate enhancements in face perception following anodal tDCS compared to sham stimulation, which were observed with a medium effect size and group sample sizes of 16 (Barbieri et al., 2016).
